text:
The output rails because the NMOS current falls short of the PMOS source current. The trim servo can't fix this, and its feedback loop also cuts the low-frequency gain.

The fix is a replica-bias load. A k=4 scaled copy of the branch has its gain-device gate driven by a heavily filtered vin, so it carries no signal. It generates the PMOS gate voltage, which fixes the output DC at the replica's level.

A resistor from vout to the replica diode node carries no DC current. It sets the gain to about 54 dB so the -3 dB bandwidth spec also passes.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Output rails from NMOS/PMOS current mismatch; servo loop kills low-freq gain. Use a filtered-vin scaled replica that generates the PMOS gate (exact DC match), plus a zero-DC-current resistor to the replica diode node to set gain ~54 dB so the -3 dB bandwidth also passes."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (20e-6, 14e-6, 23e-6),
    "Adb":    (54.0, 52.5, 57.0),
    "L1":     (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid3":  (14.0, 9.0, 20.0),
    "L3":     (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_p": (6.0, 4.0, 10.0),
    "Lp":     (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),
    "gmid5":  (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "L5":     (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "vds1t":  (0.25, 0.18, 0.4),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I = p["I"]
    k = 4.0                      # replica scale-down
    Ir = I / k
    Ipc = 2.5e-6
    vds1 = p["vds1t"]

    # PMOS load: output DC = vdd - vsg2 (set by replica diode)
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.3)
    vsd2 = max(m2.vdsat + 0.1, 0.2)
    for _ in range(3):
        m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=vsd2)
        vsd2 = max(m2.vdsat + 0.1, 0.2)
    vout_dc = vdd - m2.vgs
    y = vdd - vsd2
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], I, vds=max(y - vout_dc, 0.1))
    pc = y - m5.vgs
    Rc = (vdd - pc) / Ipc
    m2r = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ir, vds=vsd2)
    m5r = lut.size("p", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], Ir, vds=max(y - vout_dc, 0.1))

    # NMOS cascode bias from ibias diode
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I, vds=max(vout_dc - vds1, 0.1), vsb=vds1)
    vbn_t = m3.vgs + vds1
    lo, hi = 1.5, 25.0
    for _ in range(30):
        g = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        t = lut.size("n", g, 2.0, iref, vds=vbn_t)
        if t.vgs > vbn_t:
            lo = g
        else:
            hi = g
    gb = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gb, 2.0, iref, vds=vbn_t)
    vbn = mb0.vgs
    for _ in range(3):
        m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I, vds=max(vout_dc - vds1, 0.1), vsb=vds1)
        vds1 = max(vbn - m3.vgs, 0.1)
    m3r = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Ir, vds=max(vout_dc - vds1, 0.1), vsb=vds1)
    mbc = lut.size("n", gb, 2.0, Ipc, vds=max(pc, 0.2))

    # gain device, sized at the actual vin bias
    o1 = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["L1"], vin, vds1)
    W1 = max(0.42 * k, I / max(o1["Id"], 1e-15))
    o1 = lut.op("n", W1, p["L1"], vin, vds1)
    gm1, gds1 = o1["gm"], o1["gds"]

    # cascode output conductance and gain-setting resistor
    gout_n = gds1 * m3.gds / (m3.gm + m3.gmbs + m3.gds)
    gout_p = m2.gds * m5.gds / (m5.gm + m5.gds)
    gc = gout_n + gout_p
    Atgt = 10 ** (p["Adb"] / 20.0)
    gneed = gm1 / Atgt - gc
    Rg = (1.0 + k) / max(gneed, 1e-9)
    Rg = min(max(Rg, 1e4), 1e9)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mb0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("Mbc", "pc", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbc)
    n.R("Rc", "vdd", "pc", Rc)
    # replica branch (gate fed by heavily filtered vin -> no signal)
    n.R("Rf", "vin", "vinf", 1e9)
    n.C("Cf", "vinf", "vss", 1e-9)
    n.M("M1r", "xr", "vinf", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1 / k, p["L1"])
    n.dev("M3r", "pb", "ibias", "xr", "vss", m3r)
    n.dev("M5r", "pb", "pc", "yr", "vdd", m5r)
    n.dev("M2r", "yr", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2r)
    # main branch
    n.dev("M2", "y", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("M5", "vout", "pc", "y", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "ibias", "x", "vss", m3)
    n.M("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, p["L1"])
    # gain-setting resistor to replica node (same DC level -> zero DC current)
    n.R("Rg", "vout", "pb", Rg)

    gout = gc + (1.0 + k) / Rg
    rout = 1.0 / gout
    A = gm1 * rout
    ctot = cl + m5.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgd + m3.cgd
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rout * ctot)
    vlow = vds1 + m3.vdsat + 0.05
    vhigh = y - m5.vdsat - 0.05
    power = vdd * (iref + I + Ir + Ipc)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "gbw": gbw, "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_dc, "swing": vhigh - vlow}
```
